name: HNK CODEX — Living Grimoire UI
core_statement: A interface não representa um grimório; a interface é o Codex vivo, navegável e computacional.

visual_system.color_role: Rich chromatic identities may distinguish pillars/domains; exact canonical palette requires dedicated lock.
visual_system.motion_rule: Motion communicates state/navigation; never blocks reading.

canon_rules: Generic symbols in the concept image are visual placeholders only.
Production replaces placeholders with approved HNK glyphs/HENUVOKODAN/iconography when canonical assets exist.
No visual element may silently create a new canonical correspondence.

responsive.desktop: open two-page grimoire as primary composition
responsive.tablet: adaptive spread with preserved book object
responsive.mobile: single-page folio/navigation; no forced miniature two-page spread

performance.rule: Visual richness cannot make knowledge inaccessible.
